question: Do explicit register locals get a BP home, and which of SI/DI do they take?
header: extern int far g(int); extern void far h(int);

variants.one_register: int far f(int n){ register int a; a=g(n); h(a); return a; }
variants.two_register_ab: int far f(int n){ register int a; register int b; a=g(n); b=g(a); h(a); h(b); return a+b; }
variants.two_register_ba: int far f(int n){ register int b; register int a; a=g(n); b=g(a); h(a); h(b); return a+b; }
variants.unused_auto: int far f(int n){ int unused; h(n); return n; }
